post.summary: Registers a new user with the provided registration details and returns a JWT token upon successful registration.

requestBody.description: The registration details including email, username, password, and confirm password.

post.summary: Logs in a user with the provided credentials and returns a JWT token upon successful authentication.

requestBody.description: The login credentials including email and password.

post.summary: Logs out the currently authenticated user.

Creates a new comment on an existing forum post.
Validates post existence, applies content length restrictions, and associates the comment with the authenticated user.
Comments are immediately visible to all users and contribute to the post's discussion thread.

requestBody.description: Comment creation data including target post ID and comment content text.

200.description: Comment successfully created and saved to the database.

400.description: Invalid request data such as missing content or invalid post reference.

401.description: User is not authenticated or authentication token is invalid.

404.description: Target post does not exist or has been deleted.

post.summary:
Permanently deletes a comment from the forum.
Only the original comment author can delete their own comments. Deletion cascades to remove associated votes and references.
This operation cannot be undone and removes the comment content from all discussion threads.

requestBody.description: Comment deletion request containing the unique identifier of the comment to remove.

200.description: Comment successfully deleted and removed from the database.

400.description: Invalid request data or malformed comment identifier.

401.description: User is not authenticated or authentication token is invalid.

403.description: User does not have permission to delete this comment (not the original author).

404.description: Comment does not exist or has already been deleted.

post.summary:
Casts or updates a user's vote on a forum comment (upvote, downvote, or remove vote).
Users can change their vote at any time but cannot vote on their own comments. Vote changes are reflected immediately
in the comment's aggregate score and influence community-driven content ranking.

requestBody.description: Voting request containing comment identifier and desired vote type (upvote/downvote/none).

200.description: Vote successfully processed and comment score updated.

400.description: Invalid request data or malformed vote parameters.

401.description: User is not authenticated or authentication token is invalid.

403.description: User cannot vote on their own comment or lacks voting permissions.

404.description: Comment does not exist or has been deleted.

post.summary:
Retrieves a paginated list of forum posts with voting scores and metadata.
Posts are ordered by popularity and activity for optimal user engagement.

requestBody.description: Pagination and timezone parameters for post listing.

400.description: The parameters provided in the request are invalid.

post.summary:
Retrieves complete details for a specific forum post, including content and optional comments.
Includes user voting state and edit permissions for the authenticated user.

requestBody.description: Post identifier and display options including timezone and comment inclusion.

400.description: The parameters provided in the request are invalid.

404.description: A post with the specified ID does not exist.

post.summary:
Creates a new forum post with the provided title and content.
Automatically assigns the authenticated user as the author and creates the initial revision.

requestBody.description: Post title and content for creation.

400.description: The parameters provided in the request are invalid.

404.description: A post with the specified ID does not exist.

post.summary:
Updates an existing forum post with new title and/or content.
Creates a new revision for edit history tracking and validates user permissions.

400.description: The parameters provided in the request are invalid.

403.description: The user does not have permission to edit this post.

404.description: A post with the specified ID does not exist.

post.summary:
Permanently deletes a forum post and all associated data (comments, votes, revisions).
Requires post ownership or administrative privileges for execution.

400.description: The parameters provided in the request are invalid.

403.description: The user does not have permission to delete this post.

404.description: A post with the specified ID does not exist.

post.summary:
Casts or updates a user's vote (upvote, downvote, or remove vote) on a forum post.
Updates the post's aggregate score and tracks the user's current voting state.

requestBody.description: Post identifier and desired vote type.

400.description: The parameters provided in the request are invalid.

403.description: The user does not have permission to vote on this post.

404.description: A post with the specified ID does not exist.

token.description: The JWT bearer token if authentication was successful; otherwise, null.

message.description: The error message if authentication failed; otherwise, null.

expiresAt.description: The expiration time of the token if authentication was successful; otherwise, null.

postId.description:
Unique identifier of the forum post that this comment will be attached to.
Must reference an existing, accessible post in the database.

content.description:
The text content of the comment being created.
Limited to 1024 characters to encourage concise, meaningful contributions to the discussion.
Must contain at least one character of actual content.

CommentCreationRequest.description:
Request data for creating a new comment on an existing forum post.
Contains validation attributes to ensure content quality and proper post association.

commentId.description: Unique identifier of the created comment.

CommentCreationResponse.description:
Response data returned after successfully creating a new comment.
Provides the unique identifier of the newly created comment for client reference.

commentId.description:
Unique identifier of the comment to be deleted.
Must reference an existing comment that belongs to the authenticated user.

CommentDeleteRequest.description:
Request data for permanently deleting an existing forum comment.
Only the original author of the comment has permission to perform this operation.

postId.description: Unique identifier of the parent post.

userId.description: Unique identifier of the comment author.

username.description: Display name of the comment author.

voteScore.description: Aggregate vote score for comment quality ranking.

canEdit.description: Whether the authenticated user has permission to edit this comment. If false, edit options should be hidden and voting be enabled (cannot vote on own post).

creationTime.description: Timestamp when the comment was originally posted.

CommentResponseEntry.description:
Represents a comment entry in a post's comment thread.
Optimized for display in comment lists with voting capabilities and author information.

commentId.description:
Unique identifier of the comment being voted on.
Must reference an existing comment that the user has not authored (users cannot vote on their own content).

CommentVoteRequest.description:
Request data for casting or updating a user's vote on a forum comment.
Supports upvoting, downvoting, or removing an existing vote to enable community-driven content curation.

postId.description: Unique identifier of the post containing the voted comment, useful for UI updates.

newScore.description: Updated aggregate score of the comment after applying the user's vote, calculated from all community votes.

CommentVoteResponse.description:
Response data returned after a user successfully votes on a comment.
Provides immediate feedback about the vote's impact on the comment's score and the user's current voting state.

email.description: The email address of the user.

title.description: The post title, limited to 256 characters for readability and database efficiency.

content.description: The main body content of the post, supporting rich text or markdown.

PostCreationRequest.description:
Request payload for creating a new post in the Cloudbb forum.
Contains the essential content required to author a forum post.

postId.description: The unique identifier of the newly created post.

PostCreationResponse.description:
Response returned after successfully creating a new forum post.
Contains the unique identifier that can be used to reference the created post.

postId.description: Unique identifier of the post to delete.

PostDeleteRequest.description:
Request to permanently delete a forum post and all associated data.
Requires post ownership or administrative privileges for successful execution.

postId.description: The unique identifier of the post to be edited.

title.description: The updated post title, limited to 256 characters.

content.description: The updated main body content of the post.

PostEditRequest.description: Request payload for editing an existing post in the Cloudbb forum.

postId.description: Unique identifier of the successfully edited post.

PostEditResponse.description:
Response confirming successful post edit operation.
Returns the post identifier for client-side navigation and state management.

pageNumber.description: Page number to retrieve (1-based indexing, minimum 1).

pageSize.description: Number of posts per page (minimum 1, default 20 for optimal loading).

PostListRequest.description:
Request parameters for retrieving a paginated list of forum posts.
Supports timezone-aware display, configurable page sizes, and flexible sorting for optimal user experience.

posts.description: Collection of post entries matching the request criteria.

PostListResponse.description:
Response containing a collection of forum posts for list/search operations.
Used for paginated display of posts in the forum interface.

userId.description: Unique identifier of the user who authored the post.

title.description: The post title for display in the listing.

contentPreview.description: Truncated preview of the post content for quick reading.

voteScore.description: Current voting score (upvotes minus downvotes) for post ranking.

lastModified.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the post.

revisions.description: Total number of revisions made to the post. Will be at least 1.

commentCount.description: Total number of comments associated with the post.

PostListResponseEntry.description:
Represents a single post entry in a paginated list view of forum posts.
Optimized for display in post listings with essential metadata and content preview.

PostListSortMode.description:
Defines the sorting criteria for forum post listings.
Enables users to view posts ranked by community engagement or chronological activity.

postId.description: Unique identifier of the post to retrieve.

includeComments.description: Whether to include the comment thread with the post data.

PostReadRequest.description:
Request parameters for retrieving detailed information about a specific forum post.
Allows optional inclusion of comments to reduce payload size when comments aren't needed.

userId.description: Unique identifier of the post author.

username.description: Display name of the post author.

title.description: Current post title from the latest revision.

content.description: Current post content from the latest revision.

voteScore.description: Aggregate vote score (sum of all upvotes and downvotes).

lastModified.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification (creation or edit).

revisions.description: Total number of revisions made to this post. Will be at least 1.

canEdit.description: Whether the authenticated user has permission to edit this post. If false, edit options should be hidden and voting be enabled (cannot vote on own post).

comments.description: Collection of comments on this post, included only when requested.

PostReadResponse.description:
Complete post details response including content, metadata, voting information, and optional comments.
Provides all data needed for displaying a full post view with user interaction capabilities.

postId.description: Unique identifier of the post to vote on.

PostVoteRequest.description:
Request to cast or update a user's vote on a forum post.
Supports upvote, downvote, or vote removal for community-driven content ranking.

postId.description: Unique identifier of the voted post.

newScore.description: Updated aggregate vote score after applying the user's vote.

PostVoteResponse.description:
Response containing updated vote information after a user casts or changes their vote.
Provides real-time feedback for immediate UI updates without requiring a full post refresh.

email.description:
The email address of the user to register.
Must be a valid email format in accordance with RFC 5322.
Must not already be in use.

username.description:
The username of the user to register.
Must not already be in use.

password.description: The password for the new user account.

confirmPassword.description:
Confirmation of the password for the new user account.
Must match the Password field.

SortOrder.description:
Defines the sort order for paginated items
Controls whether results are displayed with newest/highest values first or oldest/lowest values first.

timeZoneOffset.description: Direct offset from UTC when IANA ID is unavailable

TimeZone.description:
Represents timezone information for accurate timestamp display to users.
Supports both IANA timezone identifiers and direct offset specification,
enabling proper localization of dates across different geographical regions.

VoteType.description:
Represents the type of vote a user can cast on posts and comments.
Values are stored as integers to simplify score calculations (sum of vote values).

Bearer.description: Please provide a previously obtained JWT token.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Provides authentication endpoints for user registration, login, and logout.

tags.name: Comments
tags.description:
RESTful API controller for managing forum comment operations including creation, deletion, and user voting.
All endpoints require user authentication and operate within transactional contexts for data consistency.
Comments are associated with posts and support threaded discussions with community voting features.
